overview.Name: F&G Annuities & Life, Inc.
overview.Description: F&G Annuities & Life, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides annuity and life insurance products in the United States. It offers fixed indexed annuities registered index-linked annuities, pension risk transfer and indexed universal life, and multi-year guarantee annuities; immediate annuities; indexed universal life insurance; pension risk transfer solutions; and institutional funding agreements. The company distributes its products through independent agents, banks, and broker-dealers to retail annuity and life customers, as well as institutional clients. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa. F&G Annuities & Life, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Fidelity National Financial, Inc.
